;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Military Police (Russia)|military police of Russia]] says that it has started patrolling the area surrounding [[Manbij]]. [http://tass.com/world/1039114 (TASS)]
**The U.S.-backed [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] say that they captured five foreign nationals who fought for [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]]. Two are reportedly from the [[United States]], two from [[Pakistan]] and one from [[Ireland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46785140 (BBC News)] 

;Business and economy
*A bankruptcy judge grants Sears Chairman [[Eddie Lampert]] another chance to buy [[Sears]] and save it from liquidation. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/01/06/sears-rejects-eddie-lamperts-bid-to-save-company-will-liquidate-.html (CNBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Mountain View train collision]]
**Two passenger trains collide in [[Pretoria]], [[South Africa]], killing at least four people and injuring at least 620 others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/killed-hundreds-injured-rush-hour-train-crash-south/story?id=60226790 (ABC News)]
*A Vietnam-registered oil tanker explodes off [[Hong Kong]]'s southern coast, killing at least one person and leaving three others missing. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-01-08/oil-tanker-aulac-fortune-explodes-off-hong-kong/10700544 (ABC News)]

;International relations
*[[China–North Korea relations]]
**[[Supreme Leader of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] arrives in [[Beijing]] for his [[Kim–Xi meetings|fourth summit meeting]] with [[Paramount leader|Chinese leader]] [[Xi Jinping]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/01/08/asia-pacific/politics-diplomacy-asia-pacific/special-north-korean-train-enters-china-raising-speculation-kim-trip-see-xi-yonhap/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[Brazil]] formally withdraws from the [[United Nations|UN]]'s [[Global Compact for Migration]] pact; however, Brazil's Foreign Minister [[Ernesto Araújo]] says that the country will continue to accept [[Venezuela]]n refugees. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-migration/brazil-quits-un-migration-pact-will-still-take-in-venezuelan-refugees-source-idUSKCN1P22G0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*A Polish woman, Elżbieta Piotrowska, is attacked with an axe and dies from her injuries in [[Ardee]], [[County Louth]], Ireland. A man known to her was later arrested. [https://www.rte.ie/news/crime/2019/0109/1022115-ardee-louth-body/ (RTÉ)]
*An attack on a primary school in [[Beijing]] leaves 20 children injured, with three children receiving serious but non-life-threatening injuries. All injured children are receiving hospital treatment. The suspect was apprehended at the scene and an investigation has been launched. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/20-children-injured-in-chinese-primary-school-attack/ar-BBRXpMp (AP News)]
*German politician {{ill|Frank Magnitz|de}}, a member of the [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] party, was beaten unconscious by three masked assailants in the city of [[Bremen]] on Monday. AfD party leader [[Alice Weidel]] calls the attack an "assassination attempt" and politicians from other German parties condemn the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46792556 (BBC News)] 
*Aftermath of the [[Humboldt Broncos bus crash]]
**Jaskirat Sidhu, the driver involved in a fatal crash involving the [[Humboldt Broncos]], pleads guilty to 29 charges against him, including 16 counts of dangerous operation of motorized vehicle causing death and 13 counts of dangerous operation of motor vehicle causing bodily injury. [http://www.sportingnews.com/us/other-sports/news/humboldt-broncos-bus-crash-driver-pleads-guilty-charges-hockey-news-jaskirat-sidhu/tphcqltj1cni1rwrfs3t1a6wu (''Sporting News'')] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatoon/jaskirat-sidhu-pleads-guilty-humboldt-broncos-1.4969739 (CBC)]
*[[List of UAV-related incidents]]
**Flights from [[London]]'s [[Heathrow Airport]] are temporarily suspended after a report of a drone sighting in the area. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-46803713 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Malaysia]]
**Following [[Muhammad V of Kelantan]]'s abdication as [[Yang di-Pertuan Agong|King]] of Malaysia on Sunday, the [[Keeper of the Rulers' Seal]] explains that the [[Conference of Rulers]] will elect a new King on 24 January, who will assume duties immediately after taking the [[Oath of office#Yang di-Pertuan Agong and Deputy Yang di-Pertuan Agong|oath of office]] on 31 January. [http://www.asiaone.com/malaysia/new-malaysia-king-can-assume-duties-immediately-after-swearing-jan-31 (''The Star''/ANN via AsiaOne)]
*[[2017–18 Qatar diplomatic crisis|Qatar diplomatic crisis]]
**Retired [[United States Marine Corps|USMC]] General [[Anthony Zinni]] resigns as U.S. envoy for the [[Qatar]] diplomatic dispute because regional leaders couldn't agree on a "viable mediation effort" to resolve the stalemate. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/08/politics/zinni-state-departure/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/anthony-zinni-us-envoy-working-on-qatar-dispute-resigns/ (CBS News)]
*[[United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019]]
** U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] gives the [[2019 Oval Office address|first prime-time address]] of his [[First presidency of Donald Trump|tenure in office]] to talk about the partial government shutdown and its key issue, proposed increased funding for the [[Mexico–United States barrier]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/08/us/politics/donald-trump-speech.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Main-belt comet]]s
**The asteroid [[6478 Gault]], {{convert|5|km|mi|abbr=off}} in diameter, is found to have been impacted by another large (>500 metres (>0.31 miles)) asteroid in late October 2018, the largest asteroid-to-asteroid collision in recorded history. [http://www.cbat.eps.harvard.edu/cbet/RecentCBETs.html (Central Bureau for Astronomical Telegrams)]
*The [[University of Hawaii at Manoa|University of Hawaii]] reports that Lonely George, the last known member of the ''[[Achatinella apexfulva]]'' species of [[land snail]] in [[Oahu]], [[Hawaii]], died aged 14 on New Year's Day. Despite being listed as [[critically endangered]] the species is now considered [[extinct]]. [https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/2019/01/george-the-lonely-snail-dies-in-hawaii-extinction/ (''National Geographic'')]
